commit_message: Resolve Animation Set motion sources against target rigs
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0110 humanoid profiles, portable Humanoid motion, typed Animation Set sources, and target bake/package resolution.

This request makes Animation Set resolution target-aware: Native remains explicit, Auto prefers an explicit RetargetMap before Humanoid fallback, Humanoid resolves the portable variant directly, every layer is target-bound before composition, and packaged Humanoid playback only reads pre-baked output.
